crossUnitConclusion: Nearest decisions across current N05 and accepted N01–N04 were compared on visible trigger, decisive facts, selected action and resulting contract. B03-specific adjacent pairs and reasoning are detailed in SEMANTIC-CURRENT-FINAL-QA.md.
